about: The client system that plays the main menu's timelines (the MainMenu/MM_* dialogs of the level SYS_Menuscreen_Act3_B) from the menu's events: its Update runs ProcessCinematicArenaTriggers, ProcessMainMenuActiveEvents, ProcessLeaveMainMenu and ProcessOnLevelLoadedTimelines; the 'press any key' page's accept creates ecl::timeline::MainMenuActorComponent, ActivateEventCameraRequestComponent and MainMenuActiveEventComponent on two actor entities and PlayedMainMenuTriggerComponent on a cinematic trigger in one frame, and MM_Accept and MM_Accept_Temple start playing.
